items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: Yeah. Well I have Mary Lou Williams... I have the Modern Jazz Quartet... And you’d back up the musical guests too.

ctx.x: And you’d back up the musical guests too.

Yeah. Well I have Mary Lou Williams, I have Erroll Garner, I have the Modern Jazz Quartet, I have Mingus and Miles and whoever was on you know. A lot of people were on. Duke was on. But there’s no sound.
